Forms

FilterChips

Pill toggle group for filtering program, level and unit listings. Use above a results grid, never as a form field.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

FilterChips

Filtering for program and unit search — visible, tappable, instantly reversible, which matters more than a compact select on mobile.

<FilterChips label="Nível de ensino" value={sel} onChange={setSel} options={[
  { id: 'infantil', label: 'Educação Infantil', count: 12 },
  { id: 'fundamental', label: 'Ensino Fundamental', count: 28 },
  { id: 'medio', label: 'Ensino Médio', count: 19 }
]} />
  • Counts must be live result counts; a stale count is worse than none.
  • Up to ~8 chips per group; beyond that use Select or Menu.
  • Selected chips are solid primary — never colour chips by accent family (that reads as Tag, a label, not a control).
  • Filters apply immediately; never pair with an "Aplicar" button.

Plain HTML contract

Native attributes and the forwarded ref target div.rse-filter-chips. The optional __label is an eyebrow. Name the __options group, and use aria-pressed on each native button to communicate selection and drive CSS.

<div class="rse-filter-chips">
  <div class="rse-filter-chips__label">Nível de ensino</div>
  <div class="rse-filter-chips__options" role="group" aria-label="Nível de ensino">
    <button class="rse-filter-chips__chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Ensino médio<span class="rse-filter-chips__count">3</span></button>
    <button class="rse-filter-chips__chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Educação infantil</button>
    <button class="rse-filter-chips__clear" type="button">Limpar</button>
  </div>
</div>

The count above is illustrative; replace it with verified live results. JavaScript must toggle aria-pressed, filter results immediately, update counts, and show the clear button only when selection exists. Clear resets every chip. With multiple=false, selecting a chip clears the others and selecting the active chip clears the group. React calls onChange with the next id array; the caller updates value. When no visible label is supplied, give the group an accessible name in plain HTML (or provide label to the wrapper).

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
options(string | FilterChipOption)[]yesChip options — plain strings or objects with a count
valuestring[]—Selected ids
onChange(value: string[]) => void—
multipleboolean—Allow multiple selections (default true)
labelstring—Uppercase group label
showClearboolean—Show the Limpar reset link when anything is selected

Also accepts every attribute of Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onChange'>, a ref and className.
